scenes.hook: You ask an A I to summarize a webpage. The page contains instructions trying to redirect the assistant.
scenes.idea: That is prompt injection: untrusted content attempts to influence how an A I follows your task.
scenes.demo: The trick becomes more serious when an assistant can also use tools or access private information.
scenes.compare: Text on a webpage is information to inspect. It should not automatically become an instruction to obey.
scenes.takeaway: Defenses help, but the problem is not fully solved. Limit access and check important actions.
scenes.close: Should a page give orders? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for practical tech explained.
